name: color-chooser
description: Palette button above the prompt: pick the session's prompt bar color (/color) with a click

viaPrompt.title: Set the color via the prompt while Claude works
viaPrompt.description: A color picked while Claude works goes into the empty prompt as /color, and Enter sets it at once. A draft in the prompt is never replaced: the color then waits for the turn to end, as it does with this off.
